Name: Winter outfit for Maru
Author: megmom84
Description:
This outfit is based on the[url=https://rd.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1796] outfit I made for the Beta version of Maru[/url]. Colors are different because I didn't think the red went very well with her hair and skin tone. I made this with the Dynamic Clothing portion of the [url=https://rd.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/649]Longevity Mod[/url] in mind.

If you want to use this in that mod, you will have to rename the xnb to replace the correct files in their folders, for example: RT_S_Maru_Winter_Outdoors, if you want her to wear it in the winter when she is outside or RT_S_Maru_IceFestival or RT_S_Maru_WinterStar at the respective outdoor festivals.

If you simply want Maru to wear this all the time, replace Maru.xnb in the Characters folder (not the portraits folder), either in your Content, or in the appropriate XNBLoader folder for Character sprites.

I haven't done any work on portraits of any kind, so they won't have a matching portrait. If anyone is any good at that, I'd welcome it or I'll try to do it sometime. I just haven't had the courage to delve into it since it's a little more high-res than the sprite and I'm just getting the hang of the sprites.

Downloads.Description: Maru in a blue coat and beanie hat.
